chapter: New York bands and the first records
title: Seven-day weeks and the importance of radio air time
summary: In Chicago they played seven days a week with a Sunday matinee and up to thirty broadcasts a week, which was a band's lifeblood.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

Were all the jobs those long hours all the time?
IN Chicago, all the time, seven days a week. There was no day off in those days.
No.
Seven days a week.
